setup.rule: Identify companies with suspicious accounting or operations via screeners or tips
setup.quote: there's a hundred different ways it can of course you have you know the the outlier screeners that say this company is is way above in margins to their peers

entry.rule: Build short position gradually before report release
entry.quote: you often will sort of put on a position over a few days or maybe a few weeks prior to releasing the report

stop.rule: Squeal point based on risk management and hedges
stop.quote: you have a squeal point right and you have to manage that risk

exits.rule: Cover when thesis plays out or risk limits hit

sizing.rule: Limit to 5-10% of daily trading volume; never 80% of portfolio
sizing.quote: you generally don't want to be more than five or ten percent of the trading in a day
